sources.entry: Flow - Award-winning, beautiful, fast, and reliable FTP + SFTP client.

summary.name: Flow
summary.one_liner: Flow is a Mac FTP and SFTP client that adds URL copying, drag-and-drop droplets, a built-in editor, and QuickLook previews.
keywords: drag and drop upload to server
use_cases: Uploading files to a web server and copying their public URLs
Dropping files onto a droplet for zero-click uploads
Editing website code on a server and auto-saving changes
Previewing remote images, PDFs, or HTML with QuickLook
summary.what_it_does: Flow is an FTP and SFTP client for Mac. It can copy or open URLs to remote files in one click and automatically copy the URL to the clipboard after an upload. Droplets are small apps that upload files dropped onto them without opening Flow, showing a progress window and optionally copying the resulting URL. Files on a server can be edited in an external editor such as TextMate or in the built-in editor, which has syntax coloring, tabs, code completion, and a web preview; saving uploads the file. QuickLook previews remote files by pressing the spacebar.
notable: Droplets upload files with zero clicks by dropping them on a mini-app
Automatic URL copying to clipboard after upload
Built-in editor with web preview, syntax coloring, and code completion
Runner-up for Apple Design Awards in 2008
caveats: Page refers to OS X and an older release history, so current macOS compatibility is not confirmed
Pricing and license terms are not stated on the page
